features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: Starting at 1st level, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level (minimum of 1) (8). (Descriptive: the on_event temp_hp rider is reserved in the sim and does not fire.)

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: You know 2 eldritch invocations: Agonizing Blast, Armor of Shadows. (Armor of Shadows is baked into armor_class; see those features.)

features.name: Agonizing Blast
features.description: When you cast eldritch blast, add your Charisma modifier to the damage it deals on a hit. (Descriptive: no key adds a flat ability modifier to a spell's damage; damage_bonus touches weapon attacks only.)

features.name: Armor of Shadows
features.description: You can cast mage armor on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components. (Baked: mage armor lasts 8 hours and costs nothing, so armor_class is 13 + Dex with no armor worn.)

features.name: Pact Boon: Pact of the Tome
features.description: Your patron gives you a grimoire called a Book of Shadows. Choose three cantrips from any class's spell list (they needn't be from the same list); while the book is on your person, you can cast them at will. They are warlock spells for you. Chosen: Fire Bolt, Ray of Frost, Sacred Flame (in spellcasting.spells).
